checkpoints.note: CoAP option parsing has already reconstructed URI path `c/cg` from the request options and matched the leader's `mCommissioningDataGet` resource, so execution enters `Leader::HandleCommissioningGet()`.
First project-side materialization of the crashing-path MeshCoP TLV header from the request payload.

With the witnessed header `0d ff`, step 3 made `length == 255`. The next two bytes are `05 05`, so a proper extended-TLV parse would reject the record instead of treating `0xff` as a base length. The fixing diff replaces this call with `Tlv::GetValueOffset(...)` and removes the large stack copy.

The saved ASan trace reports `stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 147` at `message.cpp:526` and identifies `tlvs` in `HandleCommissioningGet()` as `[48,302)`. The requested logical copy length is 255 bytes; `Message::Read()` splits it across message-buffer chunks, and the 147-byte chunk is the one that first hits the stack redzone.
